Branch: `claude/issue-22975-c3-7a7b-8post` (the build-ahead integration branch). The PR branches are cut from `main` after S8 lands: `claude/issue-22975-7a-tests`, `claude/issue-22975-7a`, `claude/issue-22975-7b` and `claude/issue-22975-8post`. The PR that closes the card gets a fresh `Claim:` naming its branch.
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22975` (in the cloud session's own checkout)
Domain: `domain:engine` (handed out by the #15194 epic PM at the maintainer's request: 「我是想把工作量分到别的账户」)
Seat: `domain:engine#2` (seat post #20966)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `246edf5b39` and the card; stop on a breach and explain it in the report). ⛔ Classes, positions and functions only, in every artefact.
- **Cross-lane, by the hand-out:** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/` (a `domain:services` package):
  - `permission-set-projection.ts`, `seed-name-lookup.ts`, `seed-refusal-sink.ts`, `position-write-through.ts` and `position-environment-backfill.ts`, with their index exports and tests;
  - the catalog gates and `SYSTEM_ROW_PROVENANCE` in `security-plugin.ts`;
  - the two re-homed names `catalog-reference-report.ts` reads.
- `packages/core/src/security/`: read only. It supplies the mappers from PR #22959 (#22937 PR 1), which is ACCEPTed and not yet on `main`. The build-ahead tree carries that branch. ⛔ No edit to those files.
- 8-post's carriers:
  - the descriptions in `packages/platform-objects` (`sys-user-position`, `sys-invitation`, `sys-audience-binding-suggestion`);
  - the describes in `packages/spec` (`protocol.zod.ts`, `eval-user.zod.ts`, `position.zod.ts`): describe text only, `domain:spec`, with a contract review owed;
  - the `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_NAMES` drift;
  - two `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` rows in `scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs`.
- ⛔ Not the files that D (#22900), S8-T (#22962) or S8 (`claude/issue-15204-s8-catalog-objects`) own until they land. ⛔ No stacked PRs. Each PR is at most 3,000 changed lines.
Container & model: `XL` (about 5.4k lines of code in three slices plus about 3.3k lines of test deletions), `mode:cloud` (a one-shot `create_session`), `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
- 7a and 7b retire `plugin-security` exports whose only callers S8 removes. That narrows a published surface and widens nothing, so each of those PRs carries its ADR-0087 disposition (`runtime-export-retired`, the category `da9c2bf2f2` added). 8-post removes gates on objects S8 unregistered and edits describe text. Each PR declares its own line per `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`. Contract reviews are owed for the narrowing PRs and for 8-post's `packages/spec` describes.
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card (an execution card under #15204, build ahead)
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- #22937 PR 1 (PR #22959, the core mappers) is this lane's and is ACCEPTed. 7a and 7b consume it, and their PRs open after it and S8 land.
- No in-flight claim edits these `plugin-security` files (read at this stamp).
- The landing order follows #15204 (6119027520): #22939 → T1 #22897 → T2 #22898 → D #22900 → S8-T #22962 → S8 → **7a ∥ 7b → 8-post** → C7b (#15211).

Note for the build-ahead · `domain:engine` seat 2 · `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX` · 2026-10-12T09:40Z. PR #22959 (core's `permissionSetDefinitionFromRow` / `positionDefinitionFromRow`) is on `main` as `e1deaefa8f`. The integration tree no longer needs its branch. When the slices are re-cut from `main` after S8, the mappers are already there. Nothing else changes for this card.
